# FAQ-029 Engineering FAQ #29

Revision: Rev A

Question: What is the target billet temperature setting for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01)?
Answer: Set and verify the controller target to 1235 °C for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01). Confirm actual billet surface reading aligns with the controller target before feed to machining.

Question: What is the system pressure limit I must not exceed for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
Answer: The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar. Do not operate the press with system pressure above this limit; document any trips or relief activations per SOP-P1-L3-03.

Question: Which lubricant part number is specified for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03)?
Answer: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-526 for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03). Record lubricant lot and date on maintenance log at the time of application.

Question: Which lubricant part number should be used for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03)?
Answer: Use lubricant part number CFW-LUB-725 for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03). Confirm compatibility with seals and cables before servicing.

Question: Which lubricant part number is required for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01)?
Answer: The specified lubricant part number for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is CFW-LUB-938. Apply per manufacturer guidance and document application in the equipment maintenance record.

Related documents: SB-1037, SB-1038, SOP-P1-L3-03
